latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — Generator Downfall helps you detect and extract generator failure events from video clips without manual editing.

- Upload videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and specify the failure moment you want extracted.
- Automatic AI-based detection and clipping of generator failure events; delivers trimmed 1080p MP4s ready to download.
- Simple session setup with support for both NEMO_TOKEN and anonymous (free credit) authentication.
- Cloud GPU-powered processing; no local installation needed.
- Built-in handling for video, audio, and text overlays with clear API mappings for editing, exporting, previewing, and more.
- Robust error handling for token issues, file formats, export restrictions, and rate limits.
